status_as_of_cutoff: Refresh 2026-08-11: Morrow County official agenda/minutes continue to support land-use approval for LUD-N-68-24, with the August 27, 2024 Planning Commission minutes recording approval by 4 yes / 3 no. The reviewed current records confirm Amazon Data Services, Inc. as owner, Integrus as applicant, Parcel 2 of Partition Plat 2022-16 / Tax Lot 138 of Map 4N24E, and an Airport Light Industrial data-center campus adjacent to Boardman Airport. The site remains classified as approved-permitted at the land-use level only; reviewed public records did not verify building permits, certificate of occupancy, energization, commissioning, or in-service status. Public MW capacity remains undisclosed. A separate 2026 Amazon case, LUD-N-089-25 / PDX 154, is on Tax Lot 136 and is treated as related context, not merged into this Tax Lot 138 record.

actions.result_status: The commission approved LUD-N-68-24 by motion of Commissioner Kilkenny, seconded by Commissioner Cooley, with 4 yes and 3 no. Findings describe four single-story data-center buildings of approximately 215,461 square feet each, support buildings, ponds, septic/drainfield, and a separately approved power substation. Conditions require final rural addresses and zoning permits before building permits and state water/wastewater/stormwater evidence before occupancy.
actions.access_caveat: The accessible official minutes place the approval action in the 2024-08-27 Planning Commission meeting. Earlier baseline text used a 2024-09-24 packet/date trail; the refresh corrects the action date to the minutes' meeting date. Approval is land-use approval subject to conditions, not a building permit or CO.
actions.evidence_note: Verified local vote and conditions; no downstream permit or power status inferred.

actions.result_status: The county findings require a Rural Address and final Zoning Permit for each building before building permit approval, and require evidence of DEQ stormwater/industrial-wastewater, NPDES large onsite sewer, and OWRD water-right verification, with additional road, airport, lighting, and CO conditions.
actions.access_caveat: This is a condition summary in the official findings, not evidence that each prerequisite was later satisfied.
